# Rockaway Internal Medicine

> Adult internal medicine and primary care practice with two offices in Queens, New York — Jamaica and Cambria Heights. Led by Dr. Shiva Shamtoub, DO, Board Certified in Internal Medicine. Preventive care, chronic disease management, and same-week sick visits. New and existing patients welcome. Most major insurance plans accepted.

Key facts:

- Jamaica office: 147-12 Rockaway Blvd, Jamaica, NY 11436 — phone 718-732-7744
- Cambria Heights office: 219-15 Linden Blvd, Cambria Heights, NY 11411 — phone 718-509-4899
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM, Sunday closed
- Physician: Dr. Shiva Shamtoub, DO (NPI 1366586646), Internal Medicine / Primary Care; languages: English, Persian
- Patients: adults (internal medicine — not pediatrics)

## Services

- [Cardiology](https://rockawayinternalmedicine.com/services/cardiology): Heart health evaluations and management
- [Diabetes Management](https://rockawayinternalmedicine.com/services/diabetes-management): Type 1 and type 2 diabetes care
- [Hypertension Treatment](https://rockawayinternalmedicine.com/services/hypertension-treatment): Blood pressure monitoring and treatment
- [Cholesterol Testing](https://rockawayinternalmedicine.com/services/cholesterol-testing): Lipid panels and cholesterol management
- [Thyroid Treatment](https://rockawayinternalmedicine.com/services/thyroid-treatment): Thyroid disorder diagnosis and care
- [Cancer Screening](https://rockawayinternalmedicine.com/services/cancer-screening): Preventive cancer screenings
- [Neurology](https://rockawayinternalmedicine.com/services/neurology): Neurological evaluations
- [Dermatology](https://rockawayinternalmedicine.com/services/dermatology): Skin condition evaluation and treatment
- [Immunotherapy](https://rockawayinternalmedicine.com/services/immunotherapy): Allergy and immune therapies
- [Physicals & Vaccinations](https://rockawayinternalmedicine.com/services/physicals-vaccinations): Annual physicals and immunizations
- [Pain Management](https://rockawayinternalmedicine.com/services/pain-management): Chronic and acute pain care
- [Pregnancy Testing](https://rockawayinternalmedicine.com/services/pregnancy-testing): Confidential pregnancy testing
